name: Варіант 3 — Типографіка і панорама
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one finished, high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE SCREENSHOT, landscape canvas 1536 by 1024. Flat front view of a browser viewport, no laptop, no device frame, no presentation board or explanatory captions. This is a Polish personal psychologist/wellbeing practitioner site, working brand "agnieszka clarity". Respect the supplied style references: milk-paper #FEFFFA, dark olive #514A08, olive-black #171504, soft straw #EDE8CC; pale mint and lavender are secondary and need not appear in this viewport. Precise Swiss neo-grotesk typography with very large bold title, generous editorial whitespace, warm natural photography, flat surfaces and gentle 12-20px corners. No decorative illustrations, no generic icon cards, no fabricated testimonials, numbers, qualifications or team. Navigation text exactly: "agnieszka clarity", "O mnie", "Oferta", "Warsztaty", "Wydarzenia", "Sklep", "PL / UK", button "Umów sesję". Main headline exactly: "Zatrzymaj się." on one line and "Poczuj siebie." on next line. Supporting copy exactly: "Przestrzeń na spotkanie z emocjami, ciałem i sobą." Main CTA exactly "Umów sesję 1:1" with a small round olive arrow. Secondary small text may read "Brainspotting · Joga · Medytacja". Do not include real-looking prices or dates. Show the beginning of a calm next section to demonstrate hierarchy. All text must be clearly typeset and plausible at desktop scale. Composition 3, type-led editorial page with a real beach photograph: top compact milk navigation capsule. Below nav on the milk page, set the two-line bold headline extremely large, left aligned, 104-112px at 1440 scale, with a smaller supporting paragraph and olive pill CTA aligned in a right-hand column, both balanced within a 1280px content width. Beneath the text is a panoramic wide photograph taking about 440px height and nearly the full page width. Use the supplied exact beach yoga photo with the same woman in a white outfit, positioned right of center in the deep side-lunge yoga pose, hand lifted, warm pale sky and green coastal trees. Preserve the photographic scene, pose and face; no invented open arms pose. Use natural crop, no text over the woman. Tiny milk caption strip underneath photo reads "Brainspotting · Joga · Medytacja". At bottom begin a quiet milk section with "Przestrzeń dla Ciebie." in 48px. Strong white space and deliberate grid, no ornamental lines except one subtle divider if needed. This varies composition while retaining all palette/type character.
